extracted.intended_audience: legal professionals, Chamber members, policymakers, and stakeholders interested in administrative law and proxy-advisor regulation
extracted.subtask_description: A short informational/case summary page reporting on the Fifth Circuit decision in National Association of Manufacturers v. SEC, including links to opinions and amicus briefs. It is aimed at readers tracking litigation over the SEC's proxy advisor rule and Administrative Procedure Act challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arbitrary and capricious (APA) review standard
rubrics_metrics.description: The page reports that the Fifth Circuit held that the SEC’s rescission of the notice and awareness conditions of the 2020 proxy advisor rule was 'arbitrary and capricious.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This references the Administrative Procedure Act standard for judicial review of agency action; the page itself does not provide the opinion's reasoning or elaboration of how the standard was applied.
